title: Business Development Manager
description:
WE ARE HIRING OMAN 
 Position: Business Development / Technical Manager – 3D Wall Panels 
 Location: Oman
 Industry: Building Materials / Construction We are seeking a technically qualified and sales-oriented professional to market and promote 3D Wall Panel Systems to developers, contractors, and consultants. 
 Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or an equivalent qualification. Minimum 5 years of experience in sales and business development within building materials, prefabricated products, or panel systems. Experience in preparing BOQs, technical submittals, and sales presentations. Strong communication and client relationship management skills. Existing connections with contractors, developers, and consultants in Oman are preferred. Excellent English communication skills; Arabic is an added advantage. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop new business opportunities and build a strong client pipeline. Promote 3D wall panel systems to developers, contractors, and consultants. Conduct technical presentations and product demonstrations. Support tender submissions, technical approvals, and client requirements. Build and maintain strong client relationships. Achieve sales targets and expand market presence in Oman.
